root_idea.summary: The root centers on entering or passing through the midst of something.
root_idea.development: Its literal orientation is entering and moving through water; this extends to entering discourse and affairs. In Quranic usage, the discourse sense is predominantly blameworthy: engaging in vain or false talk.

senses.definition: To enter into or engage in vain or false discourse; to speak falsely or indulge in such discourse concerning a matter.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic constructions, especially with discourse, a matter, or divine signs, and with those already engaged in such talk. The sense may be rendered “engage,” “converse vainly,” or “indulge in vain talk.”

senses.definition: One who engages in vain or false discourse.
senses.usage_conditions: A participant in the blameworthy discourse described by the corresponding Form I verb; in the Quranic expression, those who engage in such talk.

senses.definition: Engaging in vain or false discourse; vain discourse.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun of خَاضَ in its Quranic discourse sense, including engaging in talk about divine signs or other blameworthy subjects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wade or ford through water, entering it and walking in or through it; with an animal, to bring it to the water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The literal sense extends to passing through an expanse such as mirage, penetrating darkness, or forcing a way through spears.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To plunge into dangers, ignorance, or an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of entering and moving through something; the source illustrates both plunging into the floods of ignorance and entering into an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Confusion or confounding in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use distinct from the Quranic noun’s discourse sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mix and stir a beverage or wine; to stir sawiq with a mixing implement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete culinary use of the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move a sword in someone after striking; specifically, to thrust it into the lower abdomen and raise it upward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic violent use with the sword as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a borrowed arrow among the arrows used in the game of maysir, in hope of gaining good luck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression connected with the pre-Islamic arrow game.
The doubled Form II is described as intensifying the underlying action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an animal wade or ford through water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV construction, used with an animal or with horses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water, to admit of being walked, waded, or forded through.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form IV use in which the water is described as passable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To constrain oneself to wade or ford in or through water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or self-directed Form V use; this is identified as the primary signification of the derived form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To occupy oneself with an affair and manage it using artifice, cunning, judgment, or discretion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form V use concerning the handling or disposal of an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquire property improperly by whatever means are possible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized interpretation reported for the construction concerning property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An implement used to mix and stir a beverage, wine, or sawiq.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete instrument noun derived from the mixing use of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ford: a place where people or animals pass through water on foot or while riding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the place or crossing itself, with documented plural forms.
